contentPattern.structure: heading row (CTA copy) + row with decorative image column and third-party (Storylane) embed URL column

suitableFor: Storylane or other third-party interactive product-tour embeds with a heading CTA
iframe embeds that need decorative background artwork around them
notSuitableFor: Vidyard videos (use vidyard-video-player or columns-media vidyard)

default: Row 1: heading text (e.g. 'Click here to take a tour of Fiix CMMS Mobile')
Row 2, column 2: embed URL (e.g. Storylane demo link)
